abilities.name: Heroic Leader
abilities.summary: Once each turning point, choose one benefit: a firefight ploy costs 0CP when this Captain is its specified ANGEL OF DEATH operative, except Command Re-roll; or, when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH activates, use Combat Doctrine at its usual CP cost if the Captain is in the killzone and outside enemy control range, provided that ploy has not already been used this turning point; or use Adjust Doctrine for 0CP while the Captain is in the killzone and outside enemy control range.

options.target: this Captain as specified ANGEL OF DEATH operative

conditions: Combat Doctrine not already used this turning point

abilities.name: Iron Halo
abilities.summary: Once in the battle, the Captain may disregard the Normal Dmg inflicted on him by one attack die when that damage is inflicted.

mechanics.trigger: one attack die inflicts Normal Dmg on this operative

abilities.name: Doctrine Warfare
abilities.summary: While this operative is in the killzone, Combat Doctrine costs 0CP when choosing Assault or Tactical. Each of those choices has its own once-per-battle use.

mechanics.trigger: use Combat Doctrine and choose a listed doctrine

abilities.name: Chapter Veteran
abilities.summary: At the end of Select Operatives, a Sergeant chosen for deployment gains one additional CHAPTER TACTIC for this battle. That extra choice may change between games of a campaign or tournament.

abilities.name: Doctrine Warfare
abilities.summary: While this operative is in the killzone, Combat Doctrine costs 0CP when choosing Devastator or Tactical. Each of those choices has its own once-per-battle use.

mechanics.trigger: use Combat Doctrine and choose a listed doctrine

abilities.name: Chapter Veteran
abilities.summary: At the end of Select Operatives, a Sergeant chosen for deployment gains one additional CHAPTER TACTIC for this battle. That extra choice may change between games of a campaign or tournament.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.summary: This operative may use frag and krak grenades without consuming the limited uses available to other operatives through universal equipment. Improve the grenade weapon's Hit stat by 1 whenever this operative uses it.

mechanics.target: this operative using frag or krak grenades

abilities.name: Camo Cloak
abilities.summary: Ignore Saturate when this operative is shot. It already has Stealthy; if Stealthy was also selected for the team, it may combine both cover options, retaining one normal and one critical cover save.

actions.name: Optics (1AP)
actions.summary: Optics costs 1AP. Until this operative's next activation starts, its shooting ignores enemy obscured status. It cannot use this action within an enemy operative's control range.

mechanics.expires: start of this operative next activation
mechanics.effect: enemy operatives cannot be obscured when this operative shoots

actions.name: Ammo Resupply
actions.summary: Before battle, place one own marker wholly in friendly territory. A friendly operative controlling the unused marker may use Ammo Resupply for 0AP unless in enemy control range. Mark that cache used for this turning point; until the next turning point starts, that operative may re-roll one attack die whenever shooting a datacard weapon.

mechanics.effect: re-roll one attack die when shooting a datacard weapon

actions.name: Stun Grenade
actions.summary: For 1AP, choose a visible enemy within 6". It and every other operative within 1" take separate D6 tests; on 3+, reduce that operative's APL by 1 until its next activation ends. Cannot be used in enemy control range or with its team pool exhausted.

mechanics.secondary: every other operative within 1 inch of primary
mechanics.expires: end of affected operative next activation

actions.name: Smoke Grenade
actions.summary: For 1AP, place a marker within 6", visible to the operative or on Vantage terrain of a visible feature. Smoke extends 1" horizontally and infinitely upwards, not below the marker. A wholly enclosed operative and others more than 2" from it are mutually obscured. Shooting at a wholly enclosed enemy changes Piercing 2/Crits 2 to the matching 1 version, unless within 2". At the next Strategy Ready step, roll D3; remove smoke after that many completed activations or the turning point ends, whichever is first. Cannot be used in enemy control range or with its pool exhausted.

mechanics.placementVisibility: visible marker OR Vantage terrain of visible feature
mechanics.obscuringCondition: operative wholly within smoke; other operative more than 2 inches away
mechanics.expiryRoll: D3 in next Strategy Ready step
mechanics.expiry: after rolled number of completed activations or end of turning point, whichever first

actions.name: Move With Barricade
actions.summary: For 1AP, Reposition up to Move minus 2" with no climb, drop, jump or remove-and-redeploy rules. Remove the connected barricade before moving, then reconnect it afterwards, more than 2" from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain; if placement is impossible, leave it removed. Counts as Reposition. Requires connection to the inside, no enemy control range, and no Fall Back/Charge in the same activation.

prohibitedMoves: remove and set up again rules
mechanics.placement: more than 2 inches from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain

tactics.name: Aggressive
tactics.summary: Give this operative's melee weapons Rending.

tactics.name: Dueller
tactics.summary: During a fight or retaliation, each normal success may block one unresolved enemy critical success. This option is unavailable against an enemy weapon with Brutal.

tactics.name: Resolute
tactics.summary: This operative may disregard APL changes, and enemy Shock does not affect it.

tactics.name: Stealthy
tactics.summary: When shot, if any cover saves can be retained, either retain one extra cover save or retain one cover save as a critical success. Do not combine this with improved cover saves from Vantage.

mechanics.condition: can retain at least one cover save

tactics.name: Mobile
tactics.summary: Reduce Fall Back's AP cost by 1. This operative may Charge while in enemy control range and leave that range to do so; the rest of the move must meet normal Charge requirements.

tactics.name: Hardy
tactics.summary: When this operative is shot, defence dice showing 5+ are critical successes.

tactics.name: Sharpshooter
tactics.summary: If this operative has not yet Charged, Fallen Back or Repositioned in its current activation, its bolt weapons gain Accurate 1 and Severe while shooting.

mechanics.condition: no Charge, Fall Back or Reposition performed in that activation

tactics.name: Siege Specialist
tactics.summary: Give this operative's ranged weapons Saturate. Enemy operatives cannot assist when this operative fights or retaliates.

teamRules.name: Astartes
teamRules.summary: In each friendly ANGEL OF DEATH activation, it may take either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. For two Shoots, at least one must use a bolt weapon; if both use its bolt sniper rifle or heavy bolter, the second costs +1AP. Friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives may counteract with either order.

secondShootExtraAP.condition: both actions use the bolt sniper rifle or both use the heavy bolter

sourceDiscrepancies.sourceValue: No once-per-battle use limit in source profile text
sourceDiscrepancies.effectiveValue: Each listed doctrine once per battle

pending: Core keyword definitions are original summaries of pinned BSData; independent current full core-rule baseline verification remains open.
Rules, ploys, terrain and equipment are reference descriptions, not executed gameplay effects.
Mission/event overrides, terrain placement and in-game state legality are not checked.

ploys.name: Combat Doctrine
ploys.summary: Choose one doctrine. Friendly ANGEL OF DEATH weapons gain Balanced while shooting a target more than 6" away for Devastator, shooting a target within 6" for Tactical, or fighting/retaliating for Assault.
ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 5; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
ploys.summary: Disregard injury-related stat changes for friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives, including their weapon stats.

mechanics.target: friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives and weapons
mechanics.ignore: stat changes caused by being injured

ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 6; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Adaptive Tactics
ploys.summary: Replace the secondary CHAPTER TACTIC for this turning point. Restore the original secondary tactic when the turning point ends.
ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 6; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Indomitus
ploys.summary: When a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is shot, rolling at least two failed defence dice lets you discard one fail and retain another as a normal success.

mechanics.trigger: friendly ANGEL OF DEATH being shot

ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 6; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Adjust Doctrine
ploys.summary: During a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH activation, before or after an action, change the selected Combat Doctrine if that strategy ploy was used during this turning point.

mechanics.timing: before or after an action during friendly ANGEL OF DEATH activation
mechanics.condition: Combat Doctrine used this turning point

ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 6; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Transhuman Physiology
ploys.summary: In Roll Defence Dice when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is shot, retain one normal defence success as a critical success instead.

mechanics.condition: friendly ANGEL OF DEATH being shot

ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 7; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Shock Assault
ploys.summary: At the start of Resolve Attack Dice in a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH Fight action, if it Charged during this activation, give its melee weapons Shock for that action. Its first strike in that sequence deals +1 damage, capped at 7.

mechanics.timing: start of Resolve Attack Dice in Fight
mechanics.condition: friendly ANGEL OF DEATH Charged during this activation

ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 7; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Wrath of Vengeance
ploys.summary: When a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative counteracts, it may perform an extra 1AP action for free. The two counteraction actions must be different.
ploys.officialLocation: Team PDF page 7; Lite Rules page 1

ploys.name: Command Re-roll
ploys.summary: After rolling attack or defence dice, re-roll one of those dice.

mechanics.timing: after rolling attack or defence dice

equipment.name: Purity Seals
equipment.summary: Once each turning point, when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH shoots, fights or retaliates and rolls at least two fails, discard one fail to retain another as a normal success.

equipment.name: Chapter Reliquaries
equipment.summary: Wrath of Vengeance costs 0CP when its specified friendly operative has an Engage order.

mechanics.condition: specified friendly operative has Engage order

equipment.name: Tilting Shields
equipment.summary: Once each turning point, while a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH fights or retaliates, use this after the opponent rolls attack dice but before re-rolls. During that sequence, the opponent cannot retain a result below 6 as a critical success, including through Lethal, Rending or Severe.

mechanics.timing: after opponent attack roll, before re-rolls

equipment.name: Auspex
equipment.summary: Once each turning point, when choosing a valid target for a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH Shoot action, use this to prevent enemy operatives within 8" of that friendly operative from being obscured until the activation or counteraction ends.

mechanics.timing: selecting valid target during friendly ANGEL OF DEATH Shoot

equipment.name: Comms Device
equipment.summary: Before battle, place one own marker wholly in friendly territory. While a friendly operative controls it, extend the distances in its SUPPORT rules referring to friendly operatives by 3". Enemy Comms Device markers provide no benefit.

equipment.name: Mines
equipment.summary: Place one own marker wholly in friendly territory before battle, more than 2" from other markers, access points and Accessible terrain. When any operative first enters its control range, remove the marker and deal D3+3 damage to that operative.

mechanics.trigger: first control-range contact by any operative

equipment.name: Ammo Cache
equipment.summary: Before battle, place one own marker wholly in friendly territory. A friendly operative controlling the unused marker may use Ammo Resupply for 0AP unless in enemy control range. Mark that cache used for this turning point; until the next turning point starts, that operative may re-roll one attack die whenever shooting a datacard weapon.

mechanics.effect: re-roll one attack die when shooting a datacard weapon

equipment.name: Razor Wire
equipment.summary: This is Exposed and Obstructing terrain. Before battle, set it wholly in friendly territory on the killzone floor, more than 2" from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain. Crossing it within 1" adds 1" to the distance travelled.

setup: more than 2 inches from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain

equipment.name: Utility Grenades
equipment.summary: Choose two grenades: two smoke, two stun, or one of each. The team may perform each grenade action only as many times in the battle as that type was selected. These 1AP actions cannot be used within enemy control range or after their pool is spent.

equipment.name: Explosive Grenades
equipment.summary: Choose two grenades: two frag, two krak, or one of each. Team-wide weapon uses for each type equal how many of that type were chosen. Explicit Grenadier grants do not consume this equipment pool.

equipment.name: Light Barricades
equipment.summary: Up to two Light barricades may be set before battle, wholly in friendly territory on the killzone floor and more than 2" from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain. Their feet are Insignificant and Exposed.

setup: more than 2 inches from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain

equipment.name: Heavy Barricade
equipment.summary: Set one Heavy barricade before battle, wholly within 4" of the friendly drop zone on the killzone floor, more than 2" from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain.

setup: wholly within 4 inches of friendly drop zone
more than 2 inches from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain

equipment.name: Ladders
equipment.summary: Up to two ladders are Insignificant and Exposed. Set them wholly in friendly territory, upright against terrain at least 2" tall, more than 2" from other equipment terrain and more than 1" from doors/access points. Once per action, treat a climb of the terrain a ladder touches as 1" vertically only if that ladder stays in control range for the entire climb. Further terrain climbs, including another ladder, use normal distance.

setup: upright against terrain at least 2 inches tall
more than 2 inches from other equipment terrain
more than 1 inch from doors and access points
mechanics.condition: same ladder within control range during entire climb

equipment.name: Portable Barricade
equipment.summary: One barricade is Light, Protective and Portable; its feet are Insignificant/Exposed. Set it wholly in friendly territory on the floor, more than 2" from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain. It gives cover only to connected operatives with the shield intervening, ignoring feet. Cover from it improves Save by 1, capped at 2+. An operative connected to its inside may use Move With Barricade.

setup: more than 2 inches from other equipment terrain, access points and Accessible terrain

equipment.name: Breaching Charge
equipment.summary: Once per battle, when a friendly operative Breaches, reduce that action's AP cost by 1 to a minimum of 1AP, treating its datacard as having a breach marker.
